messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v2.4.0 at 18:00 UTC today. Need final docs + SDK snippet sanity checks before cutoff. Any blockers?

marta: On it. I noticed one sample in the JS SDK page uses `client.generate()` still, while the SDK was changed to `client.text.generate()` in the last API stable. Will fix the snippet and push a PR.

jin: Thanks for flagging. Also seeing the docsite CI fail on `docs/snippets/sdk/js/streaming.md` because of an unterminated fenced block. I opened #4821 with the minimal fix.

sam: @marta @jin heads-up: release-bot is going to run the changelog validation at 17:20 UTC and will block cut if there are failing checks. Make sure PRs include `changelog: docs` label or add the manual entry.

marta: Copy. I'll add the changelog note and ping for review. PR is draft -> changing to ready in a sec.

ci-bot: build/docs-site — deploy preview failed for branch `release/v2.4.0` (step: render-site). Logs: "Error: Unexpected end of input in fenced code block at docs/snippets/sdk/js/streaming.md:42"

alex: Jin — can you paste the small diff or command to re-run the render locally? I can help if you want.

jin: Sure — run `make docs-serve` then `./scripts/render_preview.sh release/v2.4.0` should reproduce. Quick patch: close the missing ``` at EOF and change `const {generate} = client` to `const { text } = client` (or use `client.text.generate`). I'll push a tiny PR.

marta: PR #4890 opened: docs(js): update snippet to client.text.generate and fix fenced block. cc @alex for changelog phrasing.

alex: Nice. For changelog entry, short line: "docs(js): update SDK example for text.generate API + fix snippet formatting" — that should satisfy the validator.

sam: release-bot here: changelog-metadata OK for PR #4890. Will run final checks at 17:20 UTC. :white_check_mark:

jin: Pushed a hotfix commit and re-ran `./scripts/render_preview.sh` — preview builds locally, CI queued.

ci-bot: build/docs-site — preview build passed for PR #4890. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4890.docs.redwood.ai

marta: Reviewed and merged. Also updated the SDK regen checklist — added a quick sanity step to run `node examples/js/hello.js` against the generated package to catch runtime API mismatches.

alex: Perfect. If nothing else pops, we'll proceed with the cut at 18:00 UTC. If you want me to hold the release window for a few minutes to let additional PRs land, say so now.

sam: No more blockers reported. I'll kick the cut job at 17:55 UTC to give 5m buffer. Good work team. :tada:

release-bot: release/v2.4.0 — preflight checks passed. Next step: tagging and publishing at scheduled time (18:00 UTC).

marta: Thanks everyone. I left a follow-up note in the release checklist about adding a short step to run `node` examples during docs CI. Small wins. :smile:
